title: Ubusitani bwahize mu gitondo cya kare
intro: Mu masaha y'ituze mbere y'uko izuba rirasa, hakozwe gahunda mu ibanga. Umurage mwiza wari witeguye gusarurwa, nyamara hashyizweho icyemezo cyo gukumira imbuto zose ku bazikeneye. Mu gitondo, byose byari kugaragara nk'ibidasanzwe, kandi isomo ryari gushingwa mu mashami yijimye ku bantu bose batekereza.
clues: Twarazwe ubusitani bwiza kandi twiyemeje gusarura imbuto zabwo zose.
Twarahiye ko tuzasohoka kare mu gitondo mu gihe abakene basabye umugabane wabo bari bagisinziriye.
Twakuyeho ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose kidasobanutse mu ndahiro yacu kandi twima uburenganzira bw'abakene tutavuze niba Allah ashaka.
Twasohotse tuganira tuti “nta mukene wemerewe kwinjira mu busitani bwacu uwo munsi.”
Twiyumviriye ko dushoboye gukusanya byose no kubuza uwo ari we wese gukusanya ibiryo gufata.
Twakangutse dusanga ubusitani bwacu bwarangiritse nijoro, bwijimye nk'aho bwasaruwe, maze tuvuga ko twabuze icyo dukora kandi twicujije.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
